args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding but src/money.py was
using ROUND_HALF_UP. Fix the rounding mode so ties round to even.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Changes
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to even (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/money-round-half-even` (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)
